segments.name: Data management
segments.description: Designs, develops, markets and sells data management software and solutions to enterprises, small businesses, governments and regulated industries.
segments.evidence: Our operations are analyzed by the CODM as being part of a single industry segment: the design, development, marketing and sale of data management software and solutions.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay for cloud services and subscriptions, customer support, and licenses of data management software products and solutions.
revenueModel.evidence: Our business consists of four revenue streams: cloud services and subscriptions, customer support, license and professional service and other.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company completed the sale of its AMC business, which resulted in a gain on disposition.
changes.evidence: On May 1, 2024, the Company completed the sale of its AMC business, which resulted in a gain on disposition (see Note 19 "Acquisitions and Divestitures" for more details).

changes.text: In 2026 OpenText divested its eDOCS and Vertica businesses.
